verses.text: Yahweh told Moses, ‘I’m bringing one last plague on Pharaoh and Egypt. After that, Pharaoh will let you go. When he does, he’ll force you out completely. ⚠️
‘Tell the people that every man and woman should ask their Egyptian neighbors for silver and gold jewelry.’ 💛
Yahweh made the Egyptians look favorably on Israel. Moses had also become highly respected throughout Egypt—in Pharaoh’s officials’ eyes and among the people. 👑
Moses said, ‘This is what Yahweh says: “Around midnight, I’ll go through the middle of Egypt. 🌙
“‘Every firstborn in Egypt will die—from Pharaoh’s firstborn son sitting on the throne to the firstborn of the servant girl working at the mill, and even the firstborn of the livestock. ⚠️
“‘There will be a huge cry across Egypt, unlike anything before or anything that will come after. 😢
“‘But not even a dog will bark at any Israelite, whether person or animal. Then you’ll know Yahweh treats Egypt and Israel differently. 🐕
“‘All your officials will come down to me, bow low, and say, “Leave—you and everyone following you!” After that, I’ll go.’” Moses left Pharaoh, furious with anger. 😠
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Pharaoh won’t listen to you, so my wonders will increase throughout Egypt.’ ✨
Moses and Aaron had performed all these wonders in front of Pharaoh, but Yahweh made Pharaoh stubborn. He still wouldn’t let Israel’s people leave his land. ⚠️
